# The Grant Finder
> Real-time nonprofit grant database for organizations across the USA.

## About
The Grant Finder provides a searchable database of grants available to nonprofit organizations throughout the United States. Our platform helps nonprofits discover funding opportunities, track deadlines, and access application resources to support their missions.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://thegrantfinder.com/
- Grant Database: https://thegrantfinder.com/grants
- Blog: https://thegrantfinder.com/blog
